title: [EP-16] Native mobile app (iOS and Android)
description: Epic EP-16. A native app for the app stores, built on the existing Supabase backend, with voice expense entry (Telugu, Hindi, English and mixed). First beta on the staging sandbox. Source: MOBILE-APP-PLAN.md (6 Oct 2026).

title: [REQ-MOB-01] Mobile foundations: Expo app on the staging backend
description: REQ-MOB-01. New Expo project from the voice POC (ganesha-entry-claude); staging-only config; supabase-js client with a persistent session; navigation shell. Done when the app launches on a phone and a simulator and reads the staging Supabase. Proposed points: 3 (estimated by comparison). Sprint 9. Source: MOBILE-APP-PLAN.md M0.

title: [REQ-MOB-02] Mobile sign-in, trips list, ledger and balances
description: REQ-MOB-02. Email and password sign-in and sign-up (staging accepts Cloudflare's test token); trips list; ledger, members and balances read from the real tables and matching the web app. Production sign-in needs Turnstile in a WebView, decided before any production beta. Proposed points: 5 (estimated by comparison). Sprint 9. Source: MOBILE-APP-PLAN.md M1.

title: [REQ-MOB-03] Mobile add, edit and delete expense (keypad and manual)
description: REQ-MOB-03. Writes through the existing atomic save RPC so row-level security and the archived-trip guard apply; edit and delete; offline queue basics. Done when an expense added on the phone shows on the web app and the reverse. Proposed points: 5 (estimated by comparison). Sprint 9. Source: MOBILE-APP-PLAN.md M2.

title: [REQ-MOB-04] Voice expense Edge Function on staging
description: REQ-MOB-04. New Edge Function voice-expense: receives audio and the trip's members, calls Gemini (transcribe and translate) and an LLM parser server-side, returns drafts only (saves nothing). Keys held as function secrets, never in the app; uses consume_ai_quota and ai_usage. Parsing logic from the POC (name matching tiers, amount check, multi-expense) in _shared, with the golden set as the regression gate. Deploy to STAGING only and only after the owner's go. Proposed points: 8 (infrastructure and secrets risk). Sprint 9. Source: MOBILE-APP-PLAN.md M3.

title: [REQ-MOB-05] Mobile voice entry: record, review, multi-expense, safeguards
description: REQ-MOB-05. Recording, Gemini engine through the function, review card (Heard, 1 of 2, Please check, split summary, currency chips), add-person suggestions, garbled-audio guard read aloud, keypad fallback. Done when spoken Telugu, Hindi and English entries reach the ledger correctly with quotas enforced. Proposed points: 5 (most of it exists in the POC; the work is wiring it to the backend). Sprint 9. Source: MOBILE-APP-PLAN.md M3.

title: [REQ-MOB-06] Mobile invites and placeholder members
description: REQ-MOB-06. Join by code, share an invite, add a person who has not joined yet (a member row with no user, claimed on join). Needs a migration, applied to staging first, with the owner's OK per step. Proposed points: 8 (data-model risk). Not in Sprint 9. Source: MOBILE-APP-PLAN.md M4.

title: [REQ-MOB-07] Mobile settle up, payment links, CSV, circles and push
description: REQ-MOB-07. Settlements, payment links, CSV export, circles and push notifications, to the beta scope the owner picks. Proposed points: 13 (large; split when scoped). Not in Sprint 9. Source: MOBILE-APP-PLAN.md M5.

title: [REQ-MOB-08] Mobile store readiness and beta distribution
description: REQ-MOB-08. Apple Developer and Google Play accounts, bundle ids, icons, privacy policy and data-safety forms (voice and AI disclosure), in-app account deletion, TestFlight and Play internal testing. Owner steps: create the two developer accounts. Proposed points: 8. Not in Sprint 9. Source: MOBILE-APP-PLAN.md M6.
